evidence.observation: Reboiler reads 433-438 °C and creeps monotonically upward while every column stage sits at 63-70 °C at 500 mbar; physically implausible, consistent with a failed/drifting reboiler thermocouple
Column profile flat and stable (~70 °C top-bed to ~63 °C condenser), little separation gradient
Reflux ~0.1-0.2 L/h and distillate ~0.2-0.8 L/h, both near sensor noise floor; ratio erratic 6.4-7.8
Pressure drop steady 0.6/3.0 mbar and system pressure stable ~500 mbar, no flooding or blockage

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reading (second TC or bath setpoint/heater duty) to confirm T701 is a sensor fault rather than a real thermal excursion, plus a distillate composition/GC sample.
